biggest_catch: playtesters.net is not a paid-testing company at all — it is an old volunteer playtester-finder community for board, card and RPG games (the 'Play Testers Network'), with forum activity noting low activity as far back as 2009. There is no tester pay to verify; the catalog's '$10-$30+ per test session' has no source.
catches: The site is a community database/scheduler for hobbyist playtesters of board and role-playing games — not a company hiring or paying testers.
No payout terms, no company operator, no tester-pay page exists anywhere in official sources.
Anyone following the catalog steps (install app, reach level milestones) will find no such program at this URL.

c2.evidence: FAILED — no payout terms published anywhere; the site has no tester-pay program.

notes: The catalog entry appears to confuse playtesters.net with real paid playtesting platforms. The URL exists but describes a volunteer hobbyist community, not an earner route. Recommend removing this route from the catalog entirely, not just marking unverified.
